# SmartHomeSensorDisplay

**Class:** `SmartHomeSensorDisplay` · **Group:** [Module widgets — Smart Home](../Groups/Module-widgets-Smart-Home.md) · **Header:** [`SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h`](../../../SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h) · `#include "SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A sensor's reading and its recent history

## Overview

@brief Sensor display widget The reading with its unit, what kind of sensor it is, its recent history as a line chart (with SensorHistoryMinimumSpan as the floor of its value axis), and the alert thresholds. Read only.

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasUIElement> CreateSmartHomeSensorDisplayElement();
```

Constructors:

```cpp
SmartHomeSensorDisplay(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
SmartHomeSensorDisplay(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit SmartHomeSensorDisplay(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
